title: @types/glob is deprecated
summary: npm marks @types/glob as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. glob provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/glob only declares types; glob now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/glob from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep glob on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from glob.

verification.purpose: Type-check and build with glob's own declarations.
Run the repository tests when defined.
